overview: 2026年，Sime Darby Berhad 对多项间接全资子公司进行清盘或解散，涉及润滑油、研发及汽车销售业务；同时公司提出设立长期激励计划（员工股份授予计划与员工认股权计划），并续期股份回购授权。
overview_en: In 2026, Sime Darby Berhad carried out liquidation or dissolution of several indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries covering lubricants, R&D and motor sales businesses;

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面推进长期激励计划、股份回购授权续期，并完成多项子公司清盘或解散。

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE (I) PROPOSED ESTABLISHMENT OF A LONG TERM INCENTIVE PLAN COMPRISING AN EMPLOYEE SHARE GRANT SCHE
actions.text: 包括员工股份授予计划和员工认股权计划，合计不超过已发行普通股总数的3.0%。
actions.text_en: Proposed establishment of a long-term incentive plan comprising an employee share grant scheme and an employee share option scheme of up to 3.0% of the total number of issued ordinary shares.

actions.title: Statement to Shareholders in relation to the Proposed Renewal of Authority for the Company to Purchase its Own Shares of up to Ten Percent (
actions.text: 并续期现有股东授权及新股东授权。
actions.text_en: Proposed renewal of authority for the company to purchase up to 10% of its issued shares, and renewal of existing shareholders' mandate and proposed new shareholders' mandate.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 UMW Innovation and R&D Centre Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年9月12日解散。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary UMW Innovation and R&D Centre Sdn. Bhd. was dissolved on 12 September 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，其主要业务为润滑油、润滑脂及特种产品的制造、分销、销售和贸易。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd commenced members' voluntary winding-up; its principal activities were manufacturing, distributing, selling and trading of lubricants, greases and speciality products.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 PT UMW International 自2026年5月4日起在印度尼西亚启动清算。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary PT UMW International commenced liquidation in Indonesia with effect from 4 May 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited 于2026年5月11日解散。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited was dissolved with effect from 11 May 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd 启动成员自愿清盘，其主要业务为润滑油及特种产品的制造和贸易。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd commenced members' voluntary winding-up; its principal activities were manufacturing and trading of lubricants and specialty products.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited 于2026年2月5日经股东决议进入清算。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited was placed under liquidation following a shareholders' resolution passed on 5 February 2026.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过清盘 UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd，退出润滑油、润滑脂及特种产品的制造、分销、销售和贸易业务。
model_changes.text_en: Through the winding-up of UMW Grantt International Sdn Bhd, exited the manufacturing, distributing, selling and trading of lubricants, greases and speciality products.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过清盘 UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd，退出润滑油及特种产品的制造和贸易业务。
model_changes.text_en: Through the winding-up of UMW Lubricant International Sdn Bhd, exited the manufacturing and trading of lubricants and specialty products.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过解散 Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited，退出该汽车销售与服务实体。
model_changes.text_en: Through the dissolution of Dongguan Chuang Yi Motors Sales and Services Company Limited, exited this motor sales and services entity.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过清算 PT UMW International，退出该印度尼西亚实体。
model_changes.text_en: Through the liquidation of PT UMW International, exited this Indonesian entity.
